messages:
rachel: Quick pre-weekly KPI check  launch webinar numbers look off. dashboard shows 1,340 regs but CRM routed only 1,050. can we do a short triage here?

omid: Which dashboard/tile are you pulling from?

rachel: marketing.weekly_kpis -> registrations by channel (last_7_days) filter=launch-apr.

metrics-bot: ETL refresh completed at 06:40 UTC; looker.weekly_kpis refreshed; total_webinar_registrations: 1,340

talia: I pulled the GA export: events (webinar_signup) = 1,372. small gap. what does CRM ingest log show?

bruce: CRM shows 1,050 new leads for that campaign. rejection reasons: 162 missing company_name, 30 duplicate emails.

rachel: ok so 1,372 GA -> 1,340 Looker -> 1,050 CRM. big chunk from missing company_name. did we change validation rules?

bruce: there was a temporary strict validation (ticket VAL-592) that required company_name for source=paid between 03/22-03/24. it rejected ~158 leads.

omid: interesting — also seeing ~110 rows in GA with gclid present but utm_campaign null. our attribution pipeline classifies those as unknown until gclid-decoder runs, which is later than the ingestion job.

talia: that explains the attribution variance. propose we: (1) backfill rejected leads to CRM with company_name=null fallback, (2) add a KPI card "reg ingestion delta" to Friday board showing breakdown, (3) surface CPA delta to ads-team before the review.

rachel: agreed. @bruce can you kick the backfill and post job id? @omid can you add the ingestion delta card with counts and short explainer (cookie vs email dedupe)?

bruce: starting backfill bf-299999-01 now. ETA ~25m. will post outcome.

omid: adding KPI card now: counts -> GA:1372, Looker:1340, CRM_ingested:1050, rejected_company_name:162, dup_email:30, gclid_only:110. note added: dedupe-cookie vs dedupe-email explains residual variance.

metrics-bot: KPI card updated: "registration ingestion delta (draft)" added by omid at 08:12

ads-team: heads-up — if rejected leads are reclassified to paid, last week's paid CPA will increase. please include an estimated delta in the slide notes.

bruce: backfill completed bf-299999-01  150 records re-ingested, 12 still failing due to email parse errors. CRM routed now 1,200. job_id bf-299999-01

talia: updated Looker card with post-backfill number. residual gap ~140 likely due to attribution timing and dedupe differences.

rachel: thanks. final asks before Friday: (1) omid add a 2-line explainer on the KPI card about expected variance sources, (2) ads-team to supply CPA delta estimate (rough %), (3) bruce capture failed ids for manual review. we'll be transparent in the deck.

omid: done  explainer and counts added.

ads-team: estimated paid CPA +10% if all reclassified to paid; will join Friday 09:30 to run through implications.

bruce: failed ids uploaded to ops drive (link: https://drive.company/ops/fails/bf-299999-01).

rachel: great thanks everyone. we'll present numbers, root causes (validation rule + late gclid decode), and three remediation steps: relax non-essential validation during ingest, run gclid decoder earlier, and add a "registration ingestion" card to weekly KPIs. see you Friday. :thumbsup:
